notes: Classical entry-mean heritability from PROC MIXED variance components: H2 = sigma_g^2 / (sigma_g^2 + sigma_e^2/r). Derived from example H2_BLUP_BLUE.sas - same dataset and same PROC MIXED model (genotype random, replicate fixed, incomplete blocks random). The original script loads macro %H2_BLUE_BLUP via proc http; this bundle uses the fundamental variance component result directly. Data is inline DATALINES from the original example script.
